6.63 rsInvalidCustomPropertyName
rsInvalidCustomPropertyName is a critical error that will occur when one of the following conditions is
true:
Two or more CustomProperty elements contain the same CustomProperty.Name value within a

CustomProperties collection.
A CustomProperty.Name is empty or is not specified.

